calibration_sources: vLLM V1 Architecture & Piecewise CUDA Graph + torch.compile Design Specs (Symbolic Shapes & Shared Memory Pool)
FlashInfer & NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell Programmatic Dependent Launch (PDL cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion) Benchmarks
Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK) & Stanford ThunderKittens / Megakernel Low-Latency LLM Decode Papers

workload.cluster_node: 1 × 8×H100-80GB SXM5 Node (900 GB/s NVLink-4, $28.80/hr node cost)
workload.model_profile: 70B Dense LLM FP8 (80 Transformer layers, TP=8, 64 Q heads / 8 KV heads)
workload.serving_regime: Interactive Low-Latency Decode (Batch Size BS=8, 8K Context) + Dynamic Chunked Prefill Mix

tiers.name: Tier 1: 原生 PyTorch Eager 逐算子发射 (480 次/词 CPU 启动墙)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Vanilla PyTorch Eager Execution (480 Kernel Launches/Token CPU Bottleneck)
tiers.execution_mechanism: Host Python/C++ Dispatcher issues 480 separate cudaLaunchKernel calls per token (6 ops/layer × 80 layers)
tiers.dynamic_shape_support: 100% Native Dynamic Shapes (Zero Recompile), but severely CPU-bound
tiers.recommended_for: Local debugging and rapid model prototyping only; strictly banned in production LLM serving because the GPU sits idle 62.4% of the time waiting for CPU cudaLaunchKernel calls.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 整图静态 CUDA Graphs 多分桶捕获 (38 桶显存膨胀与补零浪费)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Monolithic Static Bucketed CUDA Graphs (38 Batch Buckets -> 18.6 GB VRAM Bloat)
tiers.execution_mechanism: Pre-captures 38 static full-model CUDA Graphs (BS=1,2,4,8..512); pads dynamic batches up to nearest bucket
tiers.dynamic_shape_support: Rigid Fixed Pointers Only (Breaks on CPU Attention metadata, MoE dynamic routing, or mixed prefill-decode)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy vLLM v0 fixed-shape Decode-only workloads; wastes 18.6 GB/GPU of KV Cache memory across 38 static buckets and still suffers un-fused HBM roundtrips.

tiers.name: Tier 3: torch.compile (Inductor 算子融合) + vLLM V1 分段 CUDA Graphs (Piecewise)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: torch.compile (TorchInductor Triton Fusion) + vLLM V1 Piecewise CUDA Graphs
tiers.execution_mechanism: Triton fuses RMSNorm+Residual+RoPE+Quant & SiLU+Mul (480->165 kernels); Piecewise Graph captures static MLP/GEMM blocks while leaving dynamic Attention flexible
tiers.dynamic_shape_support: Seamless Symbolic Shapes + Unified Chunked-Prefill & Decode (1 Graph Tree with cudaMemPool Reuse)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard enterprise production baseline (vLLM V1 / SGLang torch.compile) balancing 3.06x lower TPOT, 87% lower graph VRAM overhead (2.4 GB vs 18.6 GB), and full dynamic-shape flexibility.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 持久大内核 (Persistent Megakernel) + Hopper/Blackwell PDL 硬件级联启动
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Persistent Megakernel (FlashInfer/Mirage MPK) + Hopper/Blackwell PDL Overlap
tiers.execution_mechanism: Fuses multi-op transformer decode (Norm+QKV+Attn+Proj+NVLS AllReduce) into persistent SM resident worker blocks + CUDA Programmatic Dependent Launch (PDL) preamble overlap
tiers.dynamic_shape_support: On-Chip Task Queue & Ring-Buffer Descriptor Table (Zero Host Launch Inside Layer Loop)
tiers.recommended_for: Ultra-low-latency (<6ms TPOT, 185+ tok/s) reasoning, voice agents, and speculative verification on H100/H200/B200 clusters.
